🖼 NERON IMAGE · KREA 2

1. «📥 Модели» на ноде — скачает недостающее (официально, Comfy-Org/Krea-2).
2. Напиши, что нарисовать — можно по-русски. Run.
Внизу ноды — итоговый промпт, что ушло в модель.

📝 ПРИМЕР БОЛЬШОГО ПРОМПТА (зелёная нода ниже) — НЕ подключён нарочно.
Сложная сцена (много героев, каждого надо прописать) — встроенному промптеру не по силам; нужен свой подробный промпт. Чтобы нарисовать пример:
• соедини выход STRING зелёной ноды со входом prompt_text у Neron Image;
• автопромтер — «✍ как есть» (иначе промптер перепишет твой текст);
• форма кадра 16:9, качество 2K, резкость 0.6–0.8 (3D гладкое).
Свой промпт — пиши в зелёной ноде вместо примера.

EN: 1. «📥 Models» downloads what is missing. 2. Write what to draw, in any language. Run.
📝 The green example node is NOT connected on purpose. To draw it: connect its STRING output to prompt_text of Neron Image, set the prompter to «✍ as is», aspect 16:9, quality 2K, sharpness 0.6–0.8. Write your own big prompt there.

nodes.title: 📝 Пример большого промпта (кот-художник) / Example big prompt
widgets_values:
A bright, cheerful 3D animated film scene in the style of a modern feature cartoon, sunny late morning. A cozy artist's studio on a flat rooftop high above a colorful seaside town with terracotta roofs, white walls and a sparkling turquoise sea in the distance. The sky is clear blue with a few fluffy white clouds.

In the center of the frame, a plump ginger tabby cat with big green eyes, white chest fur and a wide happy grin stands on its hind legs on a small wooden stool in front of a tall easel. The cat wears a slightly too-big dark blue painter's beret tilted to one side and a cream linen apron splashed with paint, and holds a thin brush in one paw, adding the last stroke to a canvas that shows a glowing golden sunrise over mountains.

To the left of the cat, a small friendly robot assistant about half the cat's height helps out: a round body of polished pale-mint enameled steel with a little brass steam valve on top that puffs tiny white clouds, two big round blue glass eyes, short jointed arms and three small wheels. With both arms it lifts a wooden palette covered in bright blobs of paint toward the cat.

On the right side, a vintage film camera on a wooden tripod points at the easel, and a curious white seagull with orange legs perches on top of the camera, tilting its head at the painting.

Around them: clay pots with red geraniums and green herbs, a string of small warm light bulbs hanging over the rooftop, a striped yellow-and-white awning casting soft shade, and a few rolled-up sketches on a little round table. High in the sky behind the town, a red-and-yellow hot air balloon floats by, with the word "NERON" painted in big white letters on its side.

Soft warm sunlight from the upper right, gentle shadows, rich saturated but friendly colors, smooth stylized 3D materials, playful and joyful mood. Wide shot from slightly below eye level, 28mm lens, everything in clear focus.
